summary: Wizard/Creator FS.GG.NewSddWorkspace 0.22.0 (omitted fable-game lifecycle follows the descriptor default, #4811) publishes through the CURRENT_022 route on genuine promoted coherent 0.112.0 (fixed creator022 pin, release 419781177, source d5af6a98) and journal board-v2-product-creator-022r1. Accepted: candidate 39936317651 and original publisher 39939741711/a1 completed all eight effects at generation 17; release 421718245/tag at 6e6fb9b9; release asset 5a34a5cd and signed nuget.org caa91285 share producer payload ef06eab2; an isolated nuget.org install equals the public bytes and forwards lifecycle=typed-sdd for an omitted fable-game lifecycle against the 0.19.3 descriptor. Lessons: (1) the exact-source compatibility seal admits only progress-report additions, so any other main merge between candidate and publish invalidates the candidate and every non-report merge before squash requires a reseal; publication needs a main merge hold. (2) Preparation requires Authority main unchanged across classification, so concurrent ordinary settlement bursts can refuse a preflight without effect; dispatch after Authority is stable. (3) The first 022 journal stranded: generation 2 recorded tag intent but its immediate post-PATCH readback observed the previous head (read-after-write staleness, not a failed GET: the 52/51 GET gap is the expected fresh-ref 404), and the engine treats intent plus absent as waiting forever, so recovery cannot settle it; the fix was a fresh journal identity with the abandoned journal recorded as history. Bounded settlement of uncertain writes is proposal (ii) on #4753. A bounded admission-read retry was added as hardening only. Installed receiver qualification and the Templates verifier flip remain separate.
title: Creator 0.22 publication: fresh-journal recovery from an unsent intent and its accepted boundary
